purpose: 解释器、包来源、pip / pytest 版本、激活文件、工作区初态
cmd: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import coverage; print("coverage", coverage.__file__, coverage.__version__)'; (cd / && python -c 'import coverage; print("cwd=/ coverage", coverage.__file__)'); python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?
